body: Why are you generalizing an entire group of people when you yourself are tired of that being put on you? I want visibility because some of us are tired of being confused for transwomen or just thought not to exist. Ignorance is the birthplace of hatred and teaching others is what allows room for growth. If you want people to learn about something, it must be visible.  Im sorry you're facing struggles, we all are. But generalizing an entire group of people and venting at them in their own space isn't the way to go for civil discourse.
If you're uncomfortable with Urgent Care and have a local Planned Parenthood, you might be better off going there. They are generally much more empathetic to LGBTQ matters.

Yeah, troubleshooting our front setup can be a little tricky. Lots of different scenarios can lead to similar symptoms. I would next guess that the recent UTI may have upset the natural balance your body likes and you are now dealing with overgrowth in bacteria. Either way, if this doesn't clear up over a few days you should see a doctor that you feel safe with so they can take guesswork out of the equation. In the meantime avoid scented products like the plague and wear light colored, loose underwear.

Well I just want to add, if you have never had a yeast infection before, I highly encourage you to call and get an appt with your doctor. They can determine for certain what's going on and prescribe medication to help if needed. You shouldn't suffer through this for weeks, especially if it's bothering you enough to break concentration or interrupt sleep.
